units.zh: 己卯，吏部侍郎龍敏改尚書左丞。
units.en: On the jimao day, Long Min was transferred to left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: On the jimao day, Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel, was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 己丑，以太子賓客楊凝式為禮部尚書致仕。
units.en: On the jichou day, Yang Ningshi, guest of the heir apparent, was granted retirement as minister of rites.
units.literal: On the jichou day, Yang Ningshi, Guest of the Heir Apparent, was granted retirement as Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 詔建錢爐於欒川。
units.en: An edict ordered coin furnaces built at Luanchuan.
units.literal: An edict ordered coin furnaces built at Luanchuan.

units.zh: 丙申，諫議大夫致仕逍遙先生鄭雲叟卒。
units.en: On the bingshen day, Zheng Yunsou, the retired remonstrance counselor known as Master Xiaoyao, died.
units.literal: On the bingshen day, Zheng Yunsou, retired Remonstrance Counselor and Master Xiaoyao, died.

units.zh: 十二月丁酉朔，百官不入閣，大雪故也。
units.en: On the first day of the twelfth month, the officials did not enter the pavilion because of heavy snow.
units.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, the dingyou day, the hundred officials did not enter the pavilion, because of heavy snow.

units.zh: 己亥，故皇子重英妻張氏落發為尼，賜名悟慎，並夏臘二十。
units.en: On the jihai day, Lady Zhang, widow of the late Prince Chongying, took the tonsure as a nun; she was given the name Wushen and twenty summers of monastic age.
units.literal: On the jihai day, Lady Zhang, wife of the late Prince Chongying, shaved her head and became a nun; she was granted the name Wushen and also given twenty summers of monastic age.

units.zh: 庚戌，禮官奏：「來歲正旦，王公上壽，皇帝舉酒，奏《元同之樂》；
units.en: On the gengxu day, the ritual officials submitted: "At New Year's Day next year, when the princes and dukes offer longevity wishes and the emperor raises his cup, the 《Music of Primal Unity》 should be performed;
units.literal: On the gengxu day, the ritual officials submitted: "At New Year's Day next year, when the princes and dukes offer longevity wishes and the Emperor raises his cup, the 《Music of Primal Unity》 should be performed;

units.zh: 再飲，奏《文同之樂》；
units.en: at the second cup, the 《Music of Cultural Unity》;
units.literal: at the second cup, the 《Music of Cultural Unity》;

units.zh: 三飲，奏同前。」
units.en: at the third cup, the same as before."
units.literal: at the third cup, the same as before."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The request was approved.

units.zh: 歌辭不錄。
units.en: The song texts are not recorded.
units.literal: The song texts are not recorded.

units.zh: 丙辰，詔今後城郭村坊，不得創造僧尼院舍。
units.en: On the bingchen day, an edict forbade the construction of new Buddhist monasteries and nunneries in cities, villages, and wards.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, an edict stated that henceforth no new compounds for Buddhist monks or nuns were to be built in walled cities, villages, or wards.

units.zh: 丁巳，帝謂宰臣曰：「大雪害民，五旬未止。
units.en: On the dingsi day, the emperor told the chief ministers, "The heavy snow is harming the people and has not stopped for fifty days.
units.literal: On the dingsi day, the Emperor said to the chief ministers: "The great snow harms the people and has not stopped for fifty days.

units.zh: 京城祠廟，悉令祈禱，了無其驗。
units.en: Temples and shrines throughout the capital have been ordered to pray, yet there has been no effect at all.
units.literal: Temples and shrines in the capital have all been ordered to pray, yet there has been no effect at all.

units.zh: 豈非涼德不儲，神休未洽者乎？」
units.en: Is this not because my meager virtue has not been stored up and divine favor has not been attained?"
units.literal: Is this not because my meager virtue has not been stored up and divine favor has not been attained?"

units.zh: 因令出薪炭米粟給軍士貧民等。
units.en: He therefore ordered fuel, charcoal, rice, and grain distributed to soldiers and the poor.
units.literal: He therefore ordered fuel, charcoal, rice, and grain distributed to soldiers, the poor, and others.

units.zh: 壬戌，禮官奏：「正旦上壽，宮懸歌舞未全，且請雜用九部雅樂，歌教坊法曲。」
units.en: On the renxu day, the ritual officials submitted: "For the New Year's longevity ceremony the palace music and dance are not yet complete; we request for the time being to use selections from the nine bureaus of elegant music and court standard melodies of the Music Office."
units.literal: On the renxu day, the ritual officials submitted: "For the New Year's longevity ceremony, the palace suspended music and dance are not complete; we request for the time being to use mixed selections from the nine bureaus of elegant music and to sing court standard melodies of the Music Office."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The request was approved.

units.zh: 甲子，都官郎中、知制誥崔棁上言，請搜訪宣宗已來野史，以備編修，從之。
units.en: On jiazi Cui Zhuang asked to gather unofficial histories since Xuanzong for compilation, and it was approved.
units.literal: On jiazi Director of Punishments, drafter of edicts Cui Zhuang memorialized asking to search for unofficial histories since Emperor Xuanzong for compilation—approved.

units.zh: 己巳，秘書少監姚顗為左散騎常侍，以太子左諭德陸崇為右散騎常侍，以兵部郎中蕭希甫為左諫議大夫，前幽州節度判官呂夢奇為右諫議大夫，以鄴都副留守孫嶽為潁州團練使。
units.en: On jisi Yao Hui became Left Regular Attendant; crown prince mentor Lu Chong became Right Regular Attendant; Xiao Xifu of Military Affairs became Left Remonstrator; Lü Mengqi, former Youzhou aide, became Right Remonstrator; Sun Yue, Yedu deputy regent, became Ying training commissioner.
units.literal: On jisi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yao Hui was made Left Regular Attendant; the crown prince's Left Mentor Lu Chong was made Right Regular Attendant; Bureau of Military Affairs director Xiao Xifu was made Left Remonstrator; former Youzhou military commissioner's aide Lü Mengqi was made Right Remonstrator; Yedu deputy regent Sun Yue was made Yingzhou training commissioner.

units.zh: 辛亥，以邢州節度使安叔千為晉州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: On xinhai Xing commissioner An Shuqian was made Jin commissioner and appointed Grand Councilor;
units.literal: On xinhai, An Shuqian, military commissioner of Xingzhou, was made military commissioner of Jinzhou and given the additional title of Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 以左拾遺、直樞密院李崧充樞密直學士。
units.en: Left Reminder Li Song, direct privy councilor, became privy council academician.
units.literal: Left Reminder and direct privy councilor Li Song became privy council academician.

units.zh: 己巳，以左衛上將軍李頃為左領軍上將軍。
units.en: On jisi Li Qing, General of the Left Guard, was made General-in-chief of the Left Leading Army.
units.literal: On jisi, Li Qing, General of the Left Guard, was made General-in-chief of the Left Leading Army.

units.zh: 以樞密使韓昭裔為中書侍郎兼兵部尚書、平章事。
units.en: Han Zhaoyi, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War and Counselor.
units.literal: Han Zhaoyi, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War and Counselor.

units.zh: 薛融，汾州平遙人。
units.en: Xue Rong came from Pingyao in Fen Prefecture.
units.literal: Xue Rong was a man of Pingyao in Fen Prefecture.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：薛融諫曰：「今宮室雖經焚毀，猶侈於帝堯之茅茨；
units.en: (Zizhi Tongjian: Xue Rong remonstrated, saying, "Although the palace halls have been burned, they are still more lavish than Emperor Yao's thatched huts;
units.literal: (Zizhi Tongjian: Xue Rong remonstrated, saying: "Although the palace halls have been burned, they are still more lavish than Emperor Yao's thatched huts;

units.zh: 清泰末，高祖將舉義，延賓席而歷問之，次及融，對曰：「融本儒生，只曾讀三五卷書，至於軍旅之事，進退存亡之機，未之學也。」
units.en: Near the end of Qingtai, as Gaozu prepared to raise the banner of rebellion, he gathered his guests and questioned each in turn. When it came to Rong, he answered, "I am only a Confucian scholar who has read a few volumes of books. As for military affairs and the timing of advance, retreat, survival, and destruction, I have never studied them."
units.literal: At the end of Qingtai, when Gaozu was about to raise the banner of rebellion, he extended the guest seats and questioned each man in turn; when it came to Rong, he replied: "Rong is originally a Confucian scholar and has read only three or five volumes of books; as for military affairs and the timing of advance, retreat, survival, and destruction, I have not studied them."

units.zh: 及登極，遷尚書吏部郎中兼侍御史知雜事。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Rong was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Personnel and concurrently appointed Attendant Censor with charge of miscellaneous censorial duties.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Rong was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Personnel of the Department of State Affairs, concurrently serving as Attendant Censor with charge of miscellaneous matters.

units.zh: 時詔修西京大內，融以鄴下用兵，國用不足，上疏復罷之，
units.en: At the time an edict ordered repairs to the inner palace at the Western Capital. Rong submitted a memorial arguing that with troops engaged below Ye and state funds exhausted, the project should again be cancelled,
units.literal: At the time an edict ordered the repair of the inner palace at the Western Capital; Rong, noting that troops were engaged below Ye and state funds were insufficient, submitted a memorial requesting that the project again be cancelled,

units.zh: 性純和，以儒學為業。
units.en: His nature was pure and gentle, and he devoted himself to Confucian learning.
units.literal: His nature was pure and gentle; he made Confucian learning his profession.

units.zh: 初從雲州帥李存璋為幕職，唐莊宗平河南，歷鄆、徐二鎮從事。
units.en: He first served on the staff of Li Cunzhang, military governor of Yunzhou; after Zhuangzong of Tang pacified Henan, he held aide posts in Yun and Xu in succession.
units.literal: At first he followed the military governor of Yun Prefecture, Li Cunzhang, as a staff member; when Zhuangzong of Tang pacified Henan, he successively served as aide in the two prefectures of Yan and Xu.

units.zh: 明宗初，授華州節度判官。
units.en: At the start of Mingzong's reign he was appointed military governor's aide at Hua Prefecture.
units.literal: At the beginning of Mingzong's reign, he was appointed military governor's aide at Hua Prefecture.

units.zh: 長興四年，入為右補闕，直宏文館，歲餘，改河東觀察判官，會高祖鎮太原，遂居於幕府。
units.en: In the fourth year of Changxing he entered court as Right Supplements Censor and served in the Hongwen Pavilion. After a little over a year he was transferred to be aide to the Hedong observation commissioner, and when Gaozu was stationed at Taiyuan he joined the governor's staff.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Changxing he entered court as Right Supplements Censor and served in the Hongwen Pavilion; after more than a year he was transferred to be aide to the Hedong observation commissioner. When Gaozu was stationed at Taiyuan, he thus took up residence in the military governor's staff.

units.zh: 天福二年，自左諫議大夫遷中書舍人，自以文學非優，不敢拜命，復為諫議。
units.en: In the second year of Tianfu he was transferred from Left Remonstrance Grand Master to Drafting Secretary, but believing himself not strong enough in literary skill, he did not dare accept the appointment and returned to his former remonstrance post.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianfu he was transferred from Left Remonstrance Grand Master to Drafting Secretary; deeming himself not superior in literary skill, he did not dare accept the appointment and returned to the post of remonstrance official.

units.zh: 俄轉御史中丞，秩滿改尚書右丞，分司西都。
units.en: Shortly afterward he was transferred to Censor-in-Chief, and when his term expired he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs at the Western Capital branch office.
units.literal: Shortly he was transferred to Censor-in-Chief; when his term expired he was changed to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, serving at the Western Capital branch.

units.zh: 座中聳然。
units.en: The whole assembly sat up in astonishment.
units.literal: The assembly was stirred to attention.

units.zh: 所費雖寡，猶多於漢文之露臺。
units.en: and although the expense may be small, it is still greater than Emperor Wen of Han's open terrace.
units.literal: Although the expense is small, it is still greater than Emperor Wen of Han's open terrace.

units.zh: 況魏城未下，公私困窘，誠非陛下修宮館之日。
units.en: Moreover, the city of Wei has not yet fallen and both public and private resources are strained. This is truly not the time for Your Majesty to repair palace halls.
units.literal: Moreover, the city of Wei has not yet fallen and both public and private resources are strained—this is truly not the day for Your Majesty to repair palace halls.

units.zh: 俟海內平寧，修之未晚。」）〉
units.en: When the realm is pacified and tranquil, it will not be too late to repair them."）〉
units.literal: When the realm within the seas is pacified and tranquil, it will not be too late to repair them."）〉

units.zh: 優詔嘉許。
units.en: An edict of warm praise commended him.
units.literal: An edict of praise commended him.

units.zh: 天福六年，以疾卒，年六十餘。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianfu he died of illness at over sixty years of age.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu he died of illness, aged over sixty.

units.zh: 己卯，以比部郎中、知制誥楊凝式為給事中，充史館修撰、判館事；
units.en: On jimao Yang Ningshi became Drafting Attendant, History Office reviser, and acting director;
units.literal: On jimao, Bureau of Review director and edict drafter Yang Ningshi was made Drafting Attendant, charged as History Office reviser and acting director;

units.zh: 帝召學士馬裔孫謂曰：「史在德語太凶，其實難容。
units.en: The Emperor summoned Academician Ma Yisun and said, "Shi Zaide's language is too harsh; it is in truth hard to tolerate.
units.literal: The Emperor summoned Academician Ma Yisun and said, "Shi Zaide's language is too harsh; in truth it is hard to tolerate.

units.zh: 爾代朕作詔，勿加在德之罪。」
units.en: Draft an edict for me and do not punish Zaide."
units.literal: You shall draft an edict for Us and do not impose punishment on Zaide."

units.zh: 詔曰：
units.en: An edict read:
units.literal: An edict stated:

units.zh: 辛巳，西面軍前奏，今月十三日，階州刺史王宏贄、瀘州刺史馮暉，自利州取山路出劍門關外倒下，殺敗董璋守關兵士三千餘人，收復劍州。
units.en: On xinsi the western front reported: on the thirteenth Jie prefect Wang Hongzan and Lu prefect Feng Hui, from Li by a mountain path outside Jianmen Pass, struck Dong Zhang's garrison of more than three thousand and recovered Jian.
units.literal: On xinsi the western-front army reported: on the thirteenth of this month Jie prefect Wang Hongzan and Lu prefect Feng Hui, from Li by a mountain path outside Jianmen Pass, came down upon Dong Zhang's garrison of more than three thousand and recovered Jian prefecture.

units.zh: 馬重績，字洞微。
units.en: Ma Zhongji, styled Dongwei.
units.literal: Ma Zhongji, style Dongwei.

units.zh: 天福三年，重績上言：「歷象，王者所以正一氣之元，宣萬邦之命，而古今所記，考審多差。
units.en: In the third Tianfu year Zhongji memorialized, "Calendars and celestial observations are how kings set the origin of cosmic order and proclaim the mandate to all states, yet records ancient and modern, when examined closely, contain many errors.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianfu, Zhongji memorialized: "The calendar and celestial signs are what kings use to rectify the origin of the single qi and proclaim the mandate to the myriad states, yet what ancient and modern records preserve, on examination, contains many errors.

units.zh: 仕晉，拜太子右贊善大夫，遷司天監。
units.en: Under Jin he was appointed right mentor of the heir apparent and then director of the astronomy bureau.
units.literal: Serving Jin, he was made Right Mentor of the Heir Apparent and transferred to director of the Astronomy Bureau.

units.zh: 少學數術，明太一、五紀、八象、三統大歷，居於太原。
units.en: From youth he studied numerology and mastered the Great One, Five Registers, Eight Images, and Great Calendar of the Three Unifications; he lived at Taiyuan.
units.literal: In youth he studied numerology and was versed in the Great One, the Five Registers, the Eight Images, and the Great Calendar of the Three Unifications; he lived at Taiyuan.

units.zh: 乃下詔班行之，號《調元曆》。
units.en: An edict was issued to promulgate it under the title Calendar for Adjusting the Origin.
units.literal: An edict was then issued to promulgate it; it was titled the Calendar for Adjusting the Origin.

units.zh: 重績卒年六十四。
units.en: Zhongji died at sixty-four.
units.literal: Zhongji died at the age of sixty-four.

units.zh: 《宣明》氣朔正而星度不驗，《崇元》五星得而歲差一日。
units.en: The Xuanming calendar's qi phases and new moons are correct, but its star positions fail verification; the Chongyuan tracks the five planets correctly but the year is off by a day.
units.literal: The Xuanming calendar's qi and new moons are correct but the star degrees do not check; the Chongyuan gets the five planets right but the year differs by a day.

units.zh: 以《宣明》之氣朔，合《崇元》之五星，二歷相參，然後符合。
units.en: Combine the Xuanming calendar's qi phases and new moons with the Chongyuan's planetary tables; only when the two calendars are cross-checked do they agree.
units.literal: Take the qi and new moons of the Xuanming and combine them with the five planets of the Chongyuan; when the two calendars are cross-checked, then they accord.

units.zh: 自前世諸歷，皆起天正十一月為歲首，用太古甲子為上元，積歲愈多，差闊愈甚。
units.en: Earlier calendars all began the year in the eleventh month of the celestial standard and used the primordial jiazi cycle as the superior origin; the more years accumulated, the wider the error grew.
units.literal: From former ages all calendars have taken the eleventh month of the celestial standard as year-start and used the primordial jiazi cycle as superior origin; the more years accumulate, the wider the discrepancy grows.

units.zh: 臣輒合二歷，創為新法，以唐天寶十四載乙未為上元，雨水正月中氣為氣首。」
units.en: I have combined the two calendars into a new method, taking the yiwei year (Tang Tianbao 14) as the superior origin and the mid-qi of the first month of Rain Water as the start of the qi cycle."
units.literal: Your servant has combined the two calendars and created a new method, taking the yiwei year, the fourteenth year of Tang Tianbao, as superior origin and the mid-qi of the first month of Rain Water as the head of qi."

units.zh: 重績又言：「漏刻之法，以中星考晝夜為一百刻，八刻六十分刻之二十為一時，時以四刻十分為正，此自古所用也。
units.en: Zhongji also argued, "The clepsydra method divides day and night into one hundred marks by observing culmination stars; eight marks plus twenty sixtieths make one double-hour, with the fourth mark and ten parts as the standard—this is the ancient practice.
units.literal: Zhongji also said: "The method of clepsydra graduations takes the culmination stars to divide day and night into one hundred ke; eight ke and twenty sixtieths of a ke make one double-hour, and the double-hour takes the fourth ke and ten parts as correct—this is what has been used since antiquity.

units.zh: 今失其傳，以午正為時始，下侵未四刻十分而為午，由是晝夜昏曉，皆失其正，請依古改正。」
units.en: That tradition is now lost: noon is taken as the start of the hour, pushing true noon down into the fourth mark and ten parts of the wei period, so day, night, dusk, and dawn are all wrong. I ask that the ancient method be restored."
units.literal: Now the transmission is lost: they take noon as the start of the double-hour and push noon down into the fourth ke and ten parts of wei, so that day, night, dusk, and dawn all lose their correctness. I ask that it be corrected according to antiquity."

units.zh: 詔下司天監趙仁琦、張文皓等考核得失，仁琦等言：「明年庚子正月朔，用重績歷考之，皆合無舛。」
units.en: The court ordered Zhao Renqi, Zhang Wenhao, and others at the astronomy bureau to review it. They reported, "On the new year's day of the coming gengzi year, Zhongji's calendar matches observation in every respect."
units.literal: An edict sent the matter to Zhao Renqi, Zhang Wenhao, and others of the Astronomy Bureau to examine gains and losses. Renqi and the rest said: "On the new moon of the first month of next year, the gengzi year, if examined by Zhongji's calendar, all will accord without error."

units.zh: 至如重績之曆法，陳元之醫道，亦不可漏其名而弗紀也。
units.en: As for Zhongji's calendrical science and Chen Yuan's medical art, their names too must not be omitted from the record.
units.literal: As for Zhongji's calendrical method and Chen Yuan's medical art, their names likewise cannot be omitted and left unrecorded.

units.zh: 庚辰，以宋州節度使高行周為北面行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿為馬軍左廂排陣使，以右神武統軍皇甫遇為馬軍右廂排陣使，以陜州節度使王周為步軍左廂排陣使，以左羽林統軍潘環為步軍右廂排陣使。
units.en: On gengchen Song commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made overall commander of the northern campaign; Heyang commissioner Fu Yanqing was left-wing horse array marshal; Right Divine Martial commander Huangfu Yu was right-wing horse marshal; Shaan commissioner Wang Zhou was left-wing foot marshal; and Left Feathered Forest commander Pan Huan was right-wing foot marshal.
units.literal: On gengchen, Gao Xingzhou, military commissioner of Songzhou, was made overall commander of the Northern Campaign Headquarters; Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Heyang, was made array marshal of the left wing of the horse army; Huangfu Yu, commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard, was made array marshal of the right wing of the horse army; Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Shaanzhou, was made array marshal of the left wing of the foot army; Pan Huan, commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard, was made array marshal of the right wing of the foot army.

units.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。
units.en: On the first day jiaxu of the first month of spring in Kaiyun 1, battle clouds that night veiled the leader star of the Northern Dipper.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, first day jiaxu of the first year of Kaiyun, that night battle clouds covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 漢乾祐初，為左屯衛將軍，與少府監馬從斌同監造漢祖山陵法物，節財省用，減數萬計。
units.en: In Han Qianyou year one he was Left General of the Garrison Guard and, with Vice Director Ma Congbin, supervised ritual objects for Gaozu's tomb, saving materials and cutting costs by tens of thousands.
units.literal: In the first year of Han Qianyou he was Left General of the Garrison Guard and together with Vice Director of the Palace Storehouses Ma Congbin supervised the making of ritual objects for Gaozu's mausoleum, economizing materials and saving tens of thousands in cost.

units.zh: 以禮部尚書王正言為戶部尚書，以御史中丞崔協為禮部尚書，以刑部侍郎、史館修撰、判館事崔居儉為御史中丞，以尚書左丞歸靄為刑部侍郎。
units.en: Wang Zhengyan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Revenue; Cui Xie, censor-in-chief, was made Minister of Rites; Cui Jujian, Vice Minister of Punishments, History Office compiler, and acting institute director, was made censor-in-chief; and Gui Ai, Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of Punishments.
units.literal: Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan was made Minister of Revenue; censor-in-chief Cui Xie was made Minister of Rites; Punishments vice minister, History Office compiler, and acting institute director Cui Jujian was made censor-in-chief; Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Gui Ai was made Punishments vice minister.

units.zh: 兩浙節度留後、靜海軍節度、嶺南西道觀察處置等使、檢校太尉、兼中書令錢元瓘加食邑。
units.en: Qian Yuanguan of Liangzhe received added fief income.
units.literal: Liangzhe acting military commissioner, Jinghai army commissioner, Lingnan West observation commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, and concurrent Secretariat Director Qian Yuanguan received added fief income.

units.zh: 己卯，以工部侍郎任讚為左散騎常侍，以樞密直學士、左諫議大夫、充匭使閻至為工部侍郎充職。
units.en: On jimao Ren Zan became left regular cavalier and Yan Zhi minister of works.
units.literal: On jimao, Minister of Works Ren Zan was made Left Regular Cavalier; Privy Council academician, Left Remonstrator, and Pouch commissioner Yan Zhi was made Minister of Works filling the post.

units.zh: 十一月丁丑，以鄧州節度使宋彥筠為晉州節度使，以涇州節度使何建為鄧州節度使。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Dengzhou commissioner Song Yanyun was transferred to Jinzhou, and Jingzhou commissioner He Jian to Dengzhou.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Song Yanyun, military commissioner of Dengzhou, was made military commissioner of Jinzhou; He Jian, military commissioner of Jingzhou, was made military commissioner of Dengzhou.

units.zh: 丙辰，以端明殿學士李專美為兵部侍郎，以端明殿學士李崧為戶部侍郎，以翰林學士馬裔孫為禮部侍郎，以禮部郎中、充樞密院直學士呂琦為給事中，並充職如故。
units.en: On bingchen Li Zhuanmei, Duanming Hall academician, was made Vice Minister of War; Li Song, Duanming Hall academician, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Ma Yisun, Hanlin academician, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Lü Qi, Director of the Ministry of Rites and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Supervising Secretary—all retaining their concurrent posts.
units.literal: On bingchen, Li Zhuanmei, Academician of the Duanming Hall, was made Vice Minister of War; Li Song, Academician of the Duanming Hall, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Ma Yisun, Hanlin Academician, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Lü Qi, Director of the Ministry of Rites and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Supervising Secretary—all retaining their concurrent posts.

units.zh: 丁丑，以前西京副留守梁文矩為兵部尚書。
units.en: On dingchou former western capital vice defender Liang Wenju became war minister.
units.literal: On dingchou, former western capital vice defender Liang Wenju became War Minister.

units.zh: 以給事中司徒詡充集賢殿學士，判院事。
units.en: Supervising Secretary Situ Xu was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and placed in charge of the academy.
units.literal: Situ Xu, Supervising Secretary, was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and oversaw its affairs.

units.zh: 甲戌，以定州節度使李周為京兆尹，充西京留守；
units.en: On jiaxu Li Zhou, formerly of Dingzhou, was appointed metropolitan magistrate of Jingzhao and Western Capital intendant;
units.literal: On jiaxu, Li Zhou, military commissioner of Ding Prefecture, was made metropolitan magistrate of Jingzhao and garrison commander of the Western Capital;

units.zh: 辛酉，以衛尉卿邊光範為秘書監，以前吏部侍郎李詳為吏部侍郎，以前戶部侍郎顏衎為尚書右丞。
units.en: On xinyou day, Bian Guangfan moved from Chamberlain for the Guards to Director of the Palace Library; former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang returned as Vice Minister of Personnel; and former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan became Right Vice Director of State Affairs.
units.literal: On the day xinyou, Bian Guangfan, Chamberlain for the Guards, was made Director of the Palace Library; the former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Personnel; the former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 白奉進，字德升，雲州清塞軍人也。
units.en: Bai Fengjin, styled Desheng, was from the Qingsai Army in Yun prefecture.
units.literal: Bai Fengjin, styled Desheng, was a native of the Qingsai Army in Yun Prefecture.

units.zh: 奉進少善騎射，後唐武皇鎮太原，奉進謁於軍門，以求自效，武皇納於麾下。
units.en: From youth Fengjin was skilled at horseback riding and archery. When the Martial Emperor of Later Tang governed Taiyuan, Fengjin presented himself at the army gate seeking service, and the Martial Emperor took him into his command.
units.literal: Fengjin from youth was skilled at horseback riding and archery; when Later Tang Martial Emperor governed Taiyuan, Fengjin presented himself at the army gate seeking to serve; the Martial Emperor took him into his command.

units.zh: 莊宗之破夾寨也，奉進挺身首犯賊鋒，莊宗睹而壯之。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong broke the encircled camps, Fengjin was the first to charge the enemy vanguard; Zhuangzong saw this and admired his valor.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong broke the encircled camps, Fengjin thrust himself forward as the first to strike the enemy vanguard; Zhuangzong saw this and admired his valor.

units.zh: 後從戰山東河上，繼以功遷龍武指揮使。
units.en: Later he fought east of the mountains and on the Yellow River and was repeatedly promoted for merit to commander of the Dragon Martial Guard.
units.literal: Later he followed campaigns east of the mountains and on the Yellow River and was repeatedly promoted for merit to commander of the Dragon Martial Guard.

units.zh: 清泰中，加檢校右僕射、唐州刺史，治郡逾年，甚有政績。
units.en: During Qingtai he was promoted to honorary Right Vice Director and prefect of Tang prefecture; governing the prefecture for more than a year he achieved very good results.
units.literal: During Qingtai he was promoted to honorary Right Vice Director and Prefect of Tang Prefecture; governing the prefecture for more than a year he had very good administrative achievements.

units.zh: 高祖即位，征赴闕，超加檢校司徒，充護聖左廂都指揮使，遙領歙州刺史。
units.en: When Emperor Gaozu took the throne he was summoned to court, promoted beyond the usual to honorary Minister over the Masses (Situ), appointed commander of the left wing of the Imperial Guard, and given nominal charge of She prefecture.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne he was summoned to court and promoted beyond the usual to honorary Minister over the Masses (Situ), appointed commander of the left wing of the Imperial Guard, and held She Prefecture in nominal charge.

units.zh: 五月，領昭信軍節度，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。
units.en: In the fifth month he was given nominal charge of the Zhaoxin Army and appointed commander-in-chief of the Palace Horse Guard.
units.literal: In the fifth month he was given nominal charge of the Zhaoxin Army and appointed commander-in-chief of the Palace Horse Guard.

units.zh: 父曰達子，世居朔野，以弋獵為事。
units.en: His father was named Dazi; the family had lived for generations on the northern frontier and made their living by hunting with bow and arrow.
units.literal: His father was named Dazi; the family for generations lived in the northern frontier and made hunting with bow and arrow their occupation.

units.zh: 同光中，魏王繼岌伐蜀，擢為親軍指揮使。
units.en: During Tongguang, when the Prince of Wei Jiji attacked Shu, he was promoted to commander of the personal guard.
units.literal: During Tongguang, when Prince of Wei Jiji attacked Shu, he was promoted to commander of the personal guard.

units.zh: 天成、長興中，統上軍，加檢校右散騎常侍。
units.en: During Tiancheng and Changxing he commanded the upper army and was promoted to honorary Right Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: During Tiancheng and Changxing he commanded the upper army and was promoted to honorary Right Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 應順中，轉捧聖右廂都指揮使、檢校刑部尚書，賜忠順保義功臣，遙領封州刺史。
units.en: During Yingshun he was transferred to commander of the right wing of the Fengsheng Guard and honorary Minister of Justice, granted the title Loyal and Obedient Preserver of Righteousness Servitor, and given nominal charge of Feng prefecture.
units.literal: During Yingshun he was transferred to commander of the right wing of the Fengsheng Guard and honorary Minister of Justice, granted the title Loyal and Obedient Preserver of Righteousness Servitor, and held Feng Prefecture in nominal charge.

units.zh: 始奉進有女嫁於皇子重信，故高祖尤所倚愛。
units.en: Fengjin had earlier given a daughter in marriage to the prince Chongxin, so Emperor Gaozu especially relied upon and favored him.
units.literal: At first Fengjin had a daughter who married the prince Chongxin, so Gaozu especially relied upon and favored him.

units.zh: 二年，改護聖左右廂都指揮使。
units.en: In the second year he was made commander of both wings of the Imperial Guard.
units.literal: In the second year he was changed to commander of both wings of the Imperial Guard.

units.zh: 六月，範延光據鄴為亂，詔遣率騎軍三千北屯滑臺。
units.en: In the sixth month Fan Yanguang held Ye in rebellion; an edict dispatched him to lead three thousand cavalry north to encamp at Huatai.
units.literal: In the sixth month Fan Yanguang held Ye in rebellion; an edict dispatched him to lead three thousand cavalry north to encamp at Huatai.

units.zh: 時符彥饒為滑州節度使，一夕，有軍士夜掠居人，奉進捕之，凡獲五盜，三在奉進本軍，二在彥饒麾下，尋命俱斬之。
units.en: At the time Fu Yanrao was military governor of Hua prefecture. One night soldiers plundered the populace; Fengjin captured them — five thieves in all, three from his own army and two from Yanrao's command — and soon ordered all beheaded.
units.literal: At the time Fu Yanrao was military governor of Hua Prefecture; one night some soldiers plundered the populace by night; Fengjin captured them — five thieves in all, three from Fengjin's own army and two from Yanrao's command — and soon ordered all beheaded.

units.zh: 彥饒怒其不先告，深銜之。
units.en: Yanrao was angry that he had not been informed beforehand and deeply resented the affront.
units.literal: Yanrao was angry that he had not been told beforehand and deeply harbored resentment.

units.zh: 明日，奉進左右勸奉進面謝，奉進然之，以從騎數人候彥饒於牙城，既入，且述其過。
units.en: The next day Fengjin's attendants urged him to apologize in person. He agreed, and with several mounted followers waited for Yanrao at the headquarters gate. Once inside, he also explained his fault.
units.literal: The next day Fengjin's attendants urged Fengjin to go in person to apologize; Fengjin agreed, and with several mounted followers waited for Yanrao at the headquarters gate; once inside, he also explained his fault.

units.zh: 奉進曰：「軍士抵法，寧有彼我，今仆以咎自陳，而公怒不息，莫是與範延光同反耶！」
units.en: Fengjin said, "When soldiers violate the law, there is no 'them' and 'us.' I come to confess my fault, yet your anger does not cease — are you rebelling along with Fan Yanguang!"
units.literal: Fengjin said, "When soldiers violate the law, how can there be 'them' and 'us'? Now I come to confess my fault, yet your anger does not cease — could it be that you are rebelling along with Fan Yanguang!"

units.zh: 其帳下介士大噪，擒奉進殺之。
units.en: The guard soldiers under his command raised a great clamor, seized Fengjin, and killed him.
units.literal: The guard soldiers under his command raised a great clamor, seized Fengjin, and killed him.

units.zh: 高祖以奉進倉卒遇禍，嘆惜久之，詔贈太傅。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu, because Fengjin had met with sudden calamity, sighed in regret for a long time and issued an edict posthumously enfeoffing him as Grand Tutor.
units.literal: Gaozu, because Fengjin had met with sudden calamity, sighed in regret for a long time and issued an edict posthumously enfeoffing him as Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 是日，步軍都校馬萬、次校盧順密聞奉進遇害，率其步眾攻滑之子城，執彥饒送於京師，戮於班荊館北。
units.en: That day the foot army commander Ma Wan and the second commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had been killed, led their foot troops to attack the inner city of Hua, seized Yanrao, and sent him to the capital, where he was executed north of Banjing Lodge.
units.literal: That day the foot army commander Ma Wan and the second commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had met with disaster, led their foot troops to attack the inner city of Hua, seized Yanrao, and sent him to the capital, where he was executed north of Banjing Lodge.

units.zh: 以太子詹事劉嶽為兵部侍郎，以太子右庶子王權為戶部侍郎，以太子左庶子任讚為工部侍郎。
units.en: Liu Yue, crown prince mentor, became War vice minister; Wang Quan, right vice mentor, Revenue vice minister; Ren Zan, left vice mentor, Works vice minister.
units.literal: Crown Prince Mentor Liu Yue was made Vice Minister of War; Crown Prince Right Vice Mentor Wang Quan was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Crown Prince Left Vice Mentor Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of Works.
